Index: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
===================================================================
--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -146,6 +146,10 @@
 
 Online learning now checks HTTP success and versioned, count-conserving application receipts, including the ring-to-statistics credit cascade. Statistics `processed` counts existing accumulator calls whose save was acknowledged; `skipped` counts rows the existing handler did not process. Alarm scheduling is reported separately and does not prove lift publication. A failed mutation/save invalidates cached state; missing, failed or malformed acknowledgements mean unknown or not-attempted work, never a safe automatic retry. Ring receipts keep attributed credits separate from weighted eligible credits and downstream processing; append acceptance is separate from cutoff suppression and the resulting bounded ring/index depths. Current background decision/outcome callers emit one fixed numeric incomplete summary without identifiers, payloads or raw errors. Downstream waits do not hold the ring's read lock or delay the shopper response. This is handler acknowledgement, not unique-event accounting, durable reconciliation/recovery, an atomic erasure fence or publication/completeness assurance; non-idempotent exposure/credit writes are not retried.
 
+Learning ingestion has conservative application budgets independent of gamma:256KiB/1000 rows per statistics request;256-code-unit scope/item/cell components and2048-byte keys;512KiB,256 items and4096 total item-plus-slot counters per stored value. An over-cap batch is refused whole with413 and `applied:false`, before any counter save; no eviction, coarsening, remapping or retry is performed. Existing ineligible rows still count as skipped. Malformed/oversized existing state and owner mismatch return503 requiring recovery, without automatic reset. Save/reset acknowledgement failure invalidates cache; a reset-item publication failure after deletion returns503 without claiming rollback. The existing explicit reset remains available.
+
+Snapshots contain only their named identity fields and estimates, not raw statistics/configuration. Prior documents are gated at4096 rows/256KiB before indexing/building; selected keys allow at most six components/2048 bytes, and actual item/key/ancestor expansion shares the256-item/4096-counter limits. Output is capped at2MiB before response/publication. This gate follows the existing configuration read/validation, so it is not a bound on raw KV parsing/import allocation. Existing multi-component-prior interpretation is unchanged. These are application budgets tested with synthetic bounded storage, not native provider-limit or sustained-capacity proof. Historical oversized-object reconstruction, old KV snapshots/completeness policy, ring-index bounds, vocabulary/estimator/generation policy and full W10 remain separate work.
+
 ## 3. Identity
 
 All under `/v1/{tenant}/identity/`. The first two take the site key; the rest take the operator token.
